column2: STAND-IN (the grader 2026-11-19, on Lon's word in the grader's window: "Is 155/159 scripted and 27/34 scripted considered complete? if not finish."; the cqo, the line's officer, was not asked, the fleet being idle): its answer reads the clock: a Ticker every tenth of a second disposes and reopens a child dialog and runs system("free"), so how many blocks of free's lines it prints before a Quit, and their numbers, move with the time: MEASURED, a Quit after its first picture ended it twice with 5796 and 8901 bytes of free's lines (officer_09 2026-11-16); its first picture is the test
